narrative:
Material PL2__MB1EA898 exhibits moderate demand variability (CV=0.42) with a right-skewed distribution. 
The analysis identified 4 outliers which were winsorized. Lead time shows volatile behavior 
(CV=0.66), requiring careful safety stock management. The optimized policy recommends increasing 
safety stock from 5652 to 6921 units to achieve 95% service level while reducing the 
safety lead time from 3.5 to 1.89 days. Order quantity is 
constrained by storage capacity to 44514 units (EOQ would be 81836 without constraints). 
The new policy delivers significant cost savings of $2003.09 annually (59.7% reduction).

research_insights.selection_rationale: Moderate variability (CV=0.42) and continuous demand pattern suitable for standard reorder point model
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity constraint binds; order quantity reduced from EOQ
